thread:
Anya: Quick sync on Dedicated pilot scope. We need a yes/no on MVP vs v1 cuts for tenant telemetry and RBAC. Proposal: MVP = basic per-tenant cost + latency counters (no dashboard), v1 = per-route dashboards, RBAC controls for cache/model toggles, and long-retention telemetry. Reasons: infra changes for RBAC and dashboards add risk and delay pilot.

Kiran: Agree with conservative cut. Dev estimate: basic counters + export hook = ~4 dev days. Dashboards + RBAC = ~4-6 dev days plus infra review. Can do admin-only toggles for pilot via console patch.

Logan: From SRE POV, we need rollback hooks and an automated circuit-breaker if a tenant causes >1.5x error rate on a model. That can be implemented in the router in ~2 days. Also want a short retention for pilot metrics (7 days) to avoid storage cost spike.

Priya: Customer success note: Two pilot customers asked for tenant-level visibility. They were explicit about "who used how many tokens" but not about RBAC. They prefer a CSV export over dashboards for now. We can satisfy them with the basic counters + a downloadable export.

Anya: Good. Actionable cutlist:
```
MVP (ship):
- Per-tenant counters: total tokens, inference calls, P95 latency, 5xx count
- Export endpoint (CSV) for customers to pull metrics
- Short retention (7d) and sampling for heavy tenants
- Router-level circuit-breaker (error rate threshold)

v1 (defer):
- Per-route dashboards in Console
- Fine-grained RBAC for cache/model toggles
- Long-term telemetry retention & query engine
```

Kiran: One question: sampling policy for heavy tenants. Recommend 10% sampling above 10k calls/min to keep ingestion bounded. That keeps cost predictable.

Logan: Agreed. Add to rollout gating: if ingestion > 120% of expected for pilot window -> pause telemetry collection for that tenant and notify CS.

product-bot: Pilot perf snapshot: https://ops.rwd-infer/pilot-metrics (2026-03-19) - avg tokens/req down 12% on canary for target model.

Priya: I'll send the customer note offering CSV exports and clear opt-out instructions. Also will capture the deferred items and expected v1 timeline (TBD).

Anya: Rollout plan: canary to 1 tenant Tue, expand to 4 tenants Wed-Thu, GA after 5 business days of stable canary. If any tenant triggers circuit-breaker twice in 24h, roll back for that tenant and open an incident.

Kiran: I'll scope the export endpoint and sampling. Will add a lightweight e2e sim that validates P95 doesn't regress by >10% in CI.

Logan: I'll add the router circuit-breaker and monitoring alerts (pager only on pilot-owner escalation).

Priya: Will coordinate pilot tenant onboarding and opt-outs.

Anya: Decision recorded: MVP = counters + CSV export + short retention + circuit-breaker. Dashboards & RBAC deferred to v1. Filing the milestone update now. :white_check_mark:
